pandorafms_server_ip.description: IP address of the Pandora FMS server.

pandorafms_server_path.description: Path on the server where agent data files are dropped.

pandorafms_temporal.description: Temporary directory used by the agent for processing.

pandorafms_logfile.description: Path to the agent log file.

pandorfms_udp_server_auth_address.description: Address restricted for UDP server commands.

pandorfms_agent_address.description: IP address to enforce for this agent (or 'auto').

pandorfms_server_port.description: TCP port for remote server communication.

pandorfms_transfer_mode.description: Transfer mode (tentacle, ftp, ssh, or local).

pandorfms_remote_config.description: Enable remote configuration via web console (0=no, 1=yes).

pandorfms_temporal_min_size.description: Minimum available bytes in temporal directory to enable buffer.
